sections.title: 示范：图书馆服务
sections.sourceText: If your membership card is cracked, hand it to the staff member at the welcome desk. A replacement is free. Members who need a computer for Saturday's digital workshop should choose a workstation on our website before Friday; places cannot be reserved at the door. Workshop handouts are available from the welcome desk on the day. If a printing job is held because money is owed, pay the balance at the self-service terminal beside the printer. To cancel a workshop place, email us the reference number in your confirmation. Questions about the lesson itself should be discussed with the instructor when the session has finished. Reception cannot answer teaching questions.

sections.title: 引导：办公室收货
sections.sourceText: Keep the entrance clear while receiving deliveries. If chilled food arrives without a purchase number, do not accept it: the driver must take it away. Office equipment longer than eighty centimetres must be entered, with its measurements, on the delivery form on the intranet before it is moved upstairs. A box with a crushed corner may be accepted if the seal is intact; send an image of the damage to your supervisor by text. Parcels for colleagues who are away should stay at reception until they return. Ask the caretaker to open the storage room if its door is locked. Empty delivery trolleys blocking the hallway belong in the loading area.

sections.title: 独立：社区泳池
sections.sourceTitle: Willow Pool: booking and visitor notes
sections.sourceText: New swimmers wanting an evening beginners' class should select an appropriate session through the pool website; the cashier handles payments, not class reservations. If you cannot use a single-entry ticket bought at the pool, give it to the duty manager before its printed date to receive a credit. For a payment that has appeared twice on your account, bring your original paper receipt to the cashier. To change the date of an existing class booking, telephone reception at least a day ahead. Bags must be stored in lockers rather than left beside the pool. Learners borrowing goggles should get them from the instructor at the start of the class.

sections.title: 计时：员工出差
sections.sourceText: Before claiming train fares, upload a clear photograph of each ticket to the expenses portal; the accounts team cannot process claims from bank statements alone. Staff who need the company car should reserve a slot in the shared vehicle calendar. If a hotel room has the wrong bed type, speak directly to the hotel rather than the studio travel desk. Send requests for a travel advance to payroll at least five working days before departure. When your train is cancelled, buy the next available service and retain the new ticket. If you lose your office parking pass while away, collect a temporary pass from security on your return.
sections.label: GT场景原创专项练习

sections.title: 复习 A：维修咖啡馆
sections.sourceText: Our volunteers repair small household items on Saturdays. If an appliance no longer starts, photograph its model label and attach the image to your booking request so we can allocate a suitable volunteer. Owners of a torn fabric bag should bring a matching piece of cloth; our sewing team supplies thread. For a loose bicycle brake cable, choose a cycle slot rather than a general repair appointment. A missing lamp bulb must be purchased before you arrive because replacements are not stocked here. To change an appointment, reply to your confirmation message. Large items which cannot fit through our entrance should remain at home; request a video consultation instead.
sections.label: GT场景原创专项练习

sections.title: 复习 B：共享办公空间
sections.sourceText: For visitors arriving before the main doors open at nine, ask the host to meet them at the side entrance. Members who require a quiet room for a call should select an empty booth on the booking screen beside reception. If a locker key is missing, show your membership details to the desk team, who will issue a spare. Report an unreliable desk lamp through the maintenance app, including the desk number. To receive parcels larger than a shoebox, use the downstairs goods desk; reception handles smaller packages only. Members leaving after eight in the evening must tap their access card at the exit reader so the system records their departure.
